newsitem.title: UK: BZW creates further yen fixed income posts.
newsitem.headline: BZW creates further yen fixed income posts.

text.p: BZW, the investment banking arm of Barclays Group, said on Wednesday it had created five new appointments in its Yen bond operations in London and Tokyo.
"Following these appointments, BZW now boasts sales and trading capabilities across the full spectrum of Japanese fixed imcome products," BZW said in a statement.
A spokesman at BZW said the posts formed part of BZW's expansion in yen bond business in London and Tokyo that began in August 1996.

In London, Jonathan Govier has been appointed associate director and head Euroyen bond trader. He previously spent eight years in the yen bond trading department at Merrill Lynch in London, most recently as head of the yen bond trading desk.
Bruce Horne was also appointed associate director and yen bond product specialist, having previously spent 10 years at Tokai Bank with respoinsibility for yen bond sales.
Terry Webber, will join BZW as a yen repo trader, having worked in the repo market for six years at Credit Suisse First Boston. All three will report to Keith Jenkins, head of yen trading in London.
In Tokyo, Yukie Kamijo has been given responsibility for trading yen bank debentures. She previously worked for Kankaku Securities for 14 years, most recently as head of bank debentures/muni trading.
Koji Fuikuchi will join as a trader for yen agency and municipal bonds. He was at Long Term Credit Bank of Japan for seven years where he traded various spread products.
Both Kamijo and Fuikuchi will report to Akira Daimon, head of non-JGB tradng in Tokyo.
